weight_management_program.text:
PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 12/17/2025
S: 34 y/o F wants to lose weight. Prior attempts at dieting on her own over the years without sustained weight loss — loses a few kilos and regains them within months. Drinks sweet tea and soda daily. Her employer now offers a weight management benefit.
O: Wt 89.6 kg, Ht 160 cm, BMI 35.0. BP 108/72.
Exam unremarkable.

A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 35.0 — plan starting today:
 - Mediterranean-style reduced-calorie diet, target ~1600 kcal/day; cut sugar-sweetened drinks.
 - Stationary bike 30–40 minutes 4 days a week (has one at home).
 - Enrolling in the employer-sponsored weight management program with monthly coaching.
 Follow-up planned in ~3 months.
2. Eczema — stable.

S: 35 y/o F here about weight; interested in medication, specifically Wegovy. No personal/family hx MTC/MEN2, no pancreatitis, no gallbladder disease. Colonoscopy pathology: tubular adenomas, repeat in 7 years. Travel planned in October.

A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 34.8 — Plan: start semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly (Wegovy) with standard dose titration; counseled on GI side effects and on holding dose escalation during travel if GI symptoms. Recheck in 3 months.
